en_title: Gears of War: E-Day Estimated Sales Reach Just 230,000 in First Week, Analyst Says
cn_title: 《战争机器：事变日》据称首周售23万
subtitle: 订阅与买断的落差
opus_summary: 分析师估计，《战争机器：事变日》首周售出23万份，约170万玩家通过订阅游玩。他认为订阅服务侵蚀了买断收入，微软尚未确认销量，新增订阅带来的收入也不明确。

paragraphs.en: Xbox console exclusive Gears of War: E-Day is reportedly off to a soft start after reaching an estimated 230,000 copies sold in its first week.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，主机端由XBOX独占的《战争机器：事变日》首周销量估计为23万份，开局表现疲软。

paragraphs.en: The alleged sales update arrived from Alinea Analytics' head of marketing analysis, Rhys Elliott, who shared early data for the Gears prequel on X/Twitter. After arriving via early access last week (its full launch arrived this past Tuesday), Gears of War: E-Day has reportedly moved just 230,000 copies across PC and Xbox devices.
paragraphs.cn: 这一未经证实的销量消息来自Alinea Analytics市场分析负责人Rhys Elliott。他在X上分享了这部《战争机器》前传的初期数据。《战争机器：事变日》上周开放抢先体验，并于本周二正式发售。据称，该作在PC和XBOX设备上的销量合计仅为23万份。

paragraphs.en: Steam sales account for 168,000 of that number, with Xbox sales, including both console and PC, totaling just 62,000. These numbers, which are unofficial figures that have not been backed by Microsoft in any official capacity and should be taken with a grain of salt, are low for the game leading the charge on Xbox's refocus toward exclusive games, as players shift their attention from purchasing the base experience to dipping their toes in with Game Pass.
paragraphs.cn: 其中，Steam销量为168,000份，XBOX平台的主机和PC端销量合计仅为62,000份。这些并非官方数据，微软也未以任何官方形式确认，需谨慎看待。XBOX重新将重心转向独占游戏，而本作正是打头阵的作品，这样的销量显得偏低；玩家也从购买基础游戏转向通过XBOX Game Pass尝试游玩。

paragraphs.en: Game Pass is seemingly to blame for its performance related to raw copies sold on Xbox-supported devices, with Elliott saying the subscription service is "cannibalising much of the premium revenue." While that's not to say Gears of War: E-Day is having trouble garnering attention – Alinea estimated that 1.7 million players have accessed the game via Game Pass – the data does suggest that players are far more interested in access through their subscriptions rather than outright owning a copy.
paragraphs.cn: 本作在支持XBOX的设备上买断销量不佳，原因似乎在于XBOX Game Pass。Elliott表示，这项订阅服务正在「侵蚀大量买断收入」。这并不是说《战争机器：事变日》难以吸引玩家关注——Alinea估计，已有170万玩家通过XBOX Game Pass游玩本作。不过，这些数据确实表明，相比直接购买并拥有游戏，玩家更倾向于通过订阅游玩。

paragraphs.en: Of the nearly 2 million to launch Gears of War: E-Day through Game Pass, 722,000 users are believed to have paid the extra $30 to upgrade to its Premium Edition to unlock early access. Revenue earned through the Xbox ecosystem reportedly amounted to $27 million, with total earnings reaching about $37 million. How exactly Gears of War: E-Day may have factored into revenue earned through new and returning Game Pass subscriptions is currently unclear.
paragraphs.cn: 在近200万名通过XBOX Game Pass启动《战争机器：事变日》的玩家中，估计有722,000人额外支付了30美元(约合人民币201元)，升级至高级版以解锁抢先体验。据称，本作通过XBOX生态获得的收入为2,700万美元(约合人民币2亿元)，总收入约为3,700万美元(约合人民币2亿元)。至于《战争机器：事变日》为XBOX Game Pass新增订阅和回归订阅带来了多少收入，目前尚不清楚。

paragraphs.en: "While E-Day is a sublime game (it's made my top 10), these are soft numbers for a flagship when Xbox badly needs revenue wins," Elliott said. "E-Day sold 62K copies on Xbox against 722K Premium upgrades, so for every one copy sold on Xbox, nearly 12 Game Pass upgrades were sold. The $70 premium SKU is – functionally – dead on Xbox. In a world without day-one Game Pass, many of these folks would have bought E-Day at $70. They paid $30 for five days early access to something they don’t own. Xbox is, in effect, charging its most valuable customers the least, based on a hangover from a tried-and-exhausted strategy from a previous administration."
paragraphs.cn: Elliott说：「虽然《战争机器：事变日》是一款出色的游戏（它已跻身我的十佳），但XBOX急需在收入上取得好成绩，作为旗舰作品，这些数字并不理想。本作在XBOX上售出62,000份，而高级版升级售出了722,000份。因此，XBOX每卖出一份游戏，就卖出了近12份XBOX Game Pass升级。70美元(约合人民币469元)的买断版在XBOX上实际上已经没有活路了。如果没有首日加入XBOX Game Pass这回事，这些玩家中有很多人本来会花70美元(约合人民币469元)购买本作。他们花了30美元(约合人民币201元)，只为提前五天游玩一款自己并不拥有的游戏。实际上，XBOX向最有价值的客户收取的费用反而最低，而这源于上一届管理层留下的策略惯性——那套策略已经尝试过，也已经耗尽了效用。」

paragraphs.en: The idea that Game Pass has negatively affected standalone sales is something Microsoft has seemingly been internally aware of before, with 2023 documents related to the Activision Blizzard merger noting a decline in base game sales in the first year after a title is added to the service. The Xbox company told IGN at the time that the model "offers gamers and game creators more choice and opportunity in how they discover, experience, and deliver games."
paragraphs.cn: 微软内部似乎早已意识到，XBOX Game Pass会对单独购买游戏的销量产生负面影响。2023年与动视暴雪合并案有关的文件指出，游戏加入该服务后的第一年，基础游戏销量会下降。微软当时向IGN表示，这种模式「让玩家和游戏创作者在发现、体验和提供游戏时，拥有更多选择和机会」。

paragraphs.en: While Microsoft has yet to confirm official sales data, and it's unclear how Gears of War: E-Day may have driven new Game Pass subscriptions, slow sales could sour an otherwise successful launch. The Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago-led prequel emerged with strong reviews from both fans and critics, with IGN's early review, which covered only the campaign mode, awarding a 9/10 .
paragraphs.cn: 虽然微软尚未公布官方销量，《战争机器：事变日》带动了多少XBOX Game Pass新增订阅也不明确，但销量低迷可能会给原本成功的发售表现蒙上阴影。这部以马库斯·菲尼克斯和多姆·圣地亚哥为主角的前传获得了玩家和评论者的好评。IGN仅针对战役模式的初期评测给出了9分，满分10分。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this week, The Coalition studio head Mike Crump said Gears of War: E-Day is a "natural choice to be" an Xbox exclusive . He also addressed concerns around potential layoffs at the studio , while promising that the next installment in the series won't take nearly as long to make.
paragraphs.cn: 本周早些时候，The Coalition工作室负责人Mike Crump表示，让《战争机器：事变日》成为XBOX独占作品是「顺理成章的选择」。他还回应了外界对工作室可能裁员的担忧，并承诺系列下一部作品的开发时间会短得多。
